lines.text: How long did Apollo 11 walk on the Moon? Under three hours.
The moonwalk lasted two hours and thirty one minutes in July nineteen sixty nine.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin spent more than twenty one hours on the surface.
They gathered about forty seven pounds of Moon rock to bring home.
Michael Collins circled alone above. Eight days of travel for under three hours outside.
